description: This file defines a migration class for version 5.0-beta of the OrangeHRM system, performing schema updates, data modifications, and configuration changes during an upgrade process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for database and configuration updates during the OrangeHRM 5.0-beta upgrade process.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs all the schema and data modifications needed for the migration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier for this migration, which is '5.0-beta'.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the homepage URL for a specific user role.

methods.name: getEmailIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the email template ID from the database by email name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: updateEmailProcessorClassByEmailName
methods.description: Updates the class responsible for processing a specific email type.

methods.name: updateEmailTemplateSubjectAndBodyByEmailNameAndRecipientRole
methods.description: Updates the email template's subject and body for a given email name and recipient role.

methods.name: getReportDisplayGroupId
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a report display group based on its name.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByGroup
methods.description: Updates display fields associated with a specific group.

methods.name: updateReportFilterFieldByFieldName
methods.description: Updates the class responsible for a specific report filter field.

methods.name: renameReportDisplayFieldAlias
methods.description: Renames the alias of a report display field.

methods.name: renameSelectedReportFilterFieldWhereCondition
methods.description: Renames the 'where' condition value for a selected report filter.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByFieldAlias
methods.description: Updates the class responsible for a report display field by its alias.

methods.name: updateScreenModuleId
methods.description: Associates a screen with a module ID based on its URL and name.

methods.name: updateMenuItemIconNames
methods.description: Sets the icon name in the menu item's additional parameters for a given menu title.
